codes.description: Determine a valid investigative question that requires a statistical investigation.
Identify information to answer a question or solve a problem.
Justify an appropriate method for ethically gathering and representing data.
Identify types of errors and relationships among components in statistical inference methods.
Identify the null and alternative hypotheses.
Construct tabular and graphical representations of data and distributions.
Calculate summary statistics, relative positions of points within a distribution, and predicted responses.
Calculate and estimate expected counts, percentages, probabilities, and intervals.
Calculate means, standard deviations, and parameters for probability distributions.
Calculate appropriate statistical inference method results.
Describe and compare tabular and graphical representations of data, as well as summary statistics.
Justify a claim based on statistical calculations and results.
Describe distributions and compare relative positions of points within a distribution.
Interpret statistical calculations and results to assess meaning or a claim.
Justify the use of a chosen statistical inference method by verifying conditions.
Interpret results of statistical inference methods.
Justify a claim based on statistical inference method results.
